topics.who: Only technicians who administer vaccines: ACPE-accredited immunization-related CE each registration period, plus an ACPE practical injection training and current CPR

rules.notes: Registration renews annually (expires March 31) with the renewal form and no general CE requirement. The only CE in 201 KAR 2:045 is 2 hours of immunization-related CE per registration period for technicians who administer vaccines.
rules.rule_quote: A registered pharmacy technician shall renew the registration annually by providing a completed Application for Pharmacy Technician Renewal form.
